decisions.reason: The air fin cooler is core to the portfolio, and with the firm growing and holding slack there is no shortfall against aspirations to trigger problemistic search.
Dropping the overlapping Product C already consolidated the condenser line, so B now stands alone as the firm's single-tube condenser and is likely to meet aspirations.
The tube liner supports the strategic lifecycle-service business at low marginal cost, so retention is consistent with satisficing behavior.
The customized multi-model air cooler line embodies the firm's integrated-solutions strategy and spreads performance risk, making withdrawal unlikely.
The tube end repair inserts reinforce aftermarket service revenue with little resource use, and the expanding firm has no reason to redeploy those resources.
